samples.question: The map contains 16 enclosed white rooms and exactly 12 orange doorways. Each orange doorway links the two rooms on its long sides. Dark walls block travel, and rooms touching only at a corner are not connected. Is there a loop through three or more different rooms that returns to its starting room without revisiting another room? Answer yes or no.
